name: Cafe Lorenzoni
kurzbeschreibung: Café Lorenzoni in Tirol Discover the charm of Tirol at Café Lorenzoni, a cozy gem nestled in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Cafe Lorenzoni in Kitzbühel is a charming café that delights its guests with homemade cakes, exquisite coffee specialties, and a cozy atmosphere. It is a wonderful place to relax, read a good book, or chat with friends. The menu offers a fine selection of traditional Austrian pastries – from creamy Sachertorte and fluffy Apfelstrudel to tempting Topfenstrudel. These are served alongside aromatic coffee specialties, crafted with great care. The inviting interior with comfortable seating and lovely details creates a truly welcoming feel-good atmosphere.
